security_audit.summary: The static command, network, and filesystem hits are Markdown examples or Burp local proxy references, not executable code in the skill. The remaining concern is semantic: the skill provides dual-use exploitation and credential attack workflows that require stronger authorization and lab-only framing.

remediation.suggestion: Add a permission checklist and frame exploit walkthroughs as authorized lab or staging tests only.
Replace brute-force examples with controlled test-account validation and explicit lockout-safe limits.
Use harmless sentinel values where possible and mark sensitive file and command payloads as lab-only.
Require written authorization, target scope, rate limits, and escalation contacts before scans or Intruder use.

content.user_title: Test Web Apps with Burp Suite
content.value_statement: Manual web security testing can be slow without a repeatable Burp workflow. This skill guides proxy setup, request replay, scope control, scanning, and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Guides Burp proxy setup with browser configuration and CA certificate steps.
Explains HTTP interception, request editing, forwarding, and history review.
Shows Repeater workflows for parameter testing and response comparison.
Covers target scope settings and filters for focused testing.
Describes automated scan setup for Burp Suite Professional.
Provides Intruder configuration guidance for payload positions and result review.
limitations: Does not run Burp Suite or interact with targets on its own.
Requires explicit authorization for every target application.
Automated scanner guidance applies only to Burp Suite Professional.
Payload examples require manual validation and may trigger monitoring controls.

use_cases.title: Prepare an authorized web test
use_cases.description: Set proxy, scope, and browser settings before capturing application traffic.

use_cases.title: Validate a suspected defect
use_cases.description: Replay a captured request in Repeater and compare responses after controlled parameter changes.

use_cases.title: Review scan findings
use_cases.description: Use Burp issue details to document evidence, impact, and remediation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Set up Burp safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure Burp Suite for an authorized test of my staging web application. Include scope, proxy, and certificate steps.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze captured traffic
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through reviewing Burp HTTP history for an in-scope application and choosing requests for manual testing.

prompt_templates.title: Test one parameter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Repeater workflow to test one authorized parameter change and record response differences without affecting production data.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a full assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Burp Suite testing plan for an authorized assessment with scope rules, scan settings, Intruder limits, and evidence notes.

output_examples.input: I need to test my staging login form with Burp Repeater.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step Repeater workflow with scope checks, request capture steps, response comparison guidance, and evidence notes.

output_examples.input: Help me prepare a Burp Professional scan for an internal application.
output_examples.output: A scan preparation checklist covering authorization, target scope, scan depth, rate limits, monitoring contacts, and result review.

output_examples.input: I found a parameter that changes server responses.
output_examples.output: A controlled validation plan that compares baseline and modified requests, records impact, and avoids destructive changes.

best_practices: Confirm written authorization and target scope before capturing or modifying traffic.
Use Burp scope filters before scans, Intruder runs, or repeated manual requests.
Document every meaningful request, response, impact statement, and remediation recommendation.
anti_patterns: Testing production systems without approved scope, contacts, and change windows.
Running Intruder or scans without rate limits and monitoring awareness.
Treating automated scanner results as final without manual verification.

faq.question: Does this skill run Burp Suite for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance. You operate Burp Suite and control all target interactions.

faq.question: Can I use it with Burp Community Edition?
faq.answer: Yes. Proxy, Repeater, and limited Intruder guidance applies. Automated scanner steps require Burp Professional.

faq.question: Does it require authorization?
faq.answer: Yes. Use it only on applications where you have explicit permission to test.

faq.question: What outputs can it help produce?
faq.answer: It can help produce request evidence, response comparisons, scope notes, scan review notes, and remediation summaries.

faq.question: Can it confirm vulnerabilities automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure testing, but findings still need expert validation and business impact review.

faq.question: How should risky payloads be handled?
faq.answer: Use controlled lab targets, test accounts, and non-destructive payloads unless the approved scope allows more.
